Your information & your rights

Cookies & local storage

Version 2026-10-01. Last updated 1 October 2026.

In short

  • This site sets no cookies and has no analytics, advertising or social media trackers.
  • The only thing it can remember on your device is your best Pier Run score, and only if you tick a box.
  • You can delete that score at any time from the game page, or by clearing your browser data.

On this page

  1. What these technologies are
  2. What harni.uk stores on your device
  3. What the site does not use
  4. Hosting and security
  5. Managing storage
  6. If this changes

What these technologies are

Cookies are small files that a website asks your browser to keep. Local storage does a similar job inside your browser. UK rules (the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations) apply to both. They require your consent before a site stores something on your device, unless it is strictly necessary for a service you asked for. This notice covers both.

What harni.uk stores on your device

Items this website can store on your device

Cookies set by this siteNone.Not applicable.Not applicable.Not applicable.
harni.pier-run.bestLocal storage on the game page.Remembers your best Pier Run score on this device.Until you delete it or clear your browser data.Yes. It is saved only after you tick “Remember my best score on this device”. The box is unticked on every visit.

The score is never sent to me or to anyone else. If you untick the box, or press “Delete saved score”, the stored score is removed. If your browser blocks storage the page says so instead of pretending it worked.

What the site does not use

The pages load no analytics, advertising or tracking code, no embedded social media feeds, no third-party video players and no external fonts, images or map services. Links to Amazon, Instagram and TikTok are ordinary links: those companies only see you after you follow them, and their own cookie notices then apply.

Hosting and security

The live site is delivered by a web host and through Cloudflare. To keep the site fast and secure, and to stop abusive traffic, those services may set or read essential security items, for example when they check that a visitor is not a robot. These are strictly necessary for security, they are not used for advertising, and they depend on the live configuration, which can change. They are separate from the Pier Run score above.

Managing storage

You can see, block or delete cookies and local storage in your browser's settings. Blocking them will not stop you reading the site or playing the game; your score just will not be remembered.

If this changes

If I ever add analytics or another tool that stores or reads information on your device, I will ask for your consent first, with equally easy Accept and Reject choices, and update this notice and the privacy notice before it starts. Questions: info@harni.uk.
